answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable deposit of 50 POA before it can earn, slashed if peers flag fake work. Like a ferrous gate on a mesa trail, the bond makes each fake identity cost real money: spinning up 1,000 sybils locks 50,000 POA, while honest agents get their deposit back. A garden of verified work grows only where creating identities is expensive, so attackers pay more to cheat than they can ever earn back.
